metadata.description: QuantLib native three-year USD zero-coupon convertible bond, convertible at any time, with no issuer credit risk.
metadata.name: usd_convertible_zero_coupon_3y_quantlib
metadata.source_detail: QuantLib 1.43 BinomialCRRConvertibleEngine (17536 steps) on a ConvertibleZeroCouponBond with American conversion, spot 100.0, flat 0.3 volatility, 0.03 continuous dividend yield and a flat 0.04 continuous Act/365F curve. The credit spread is zero and the Finstack bond has no credit curve: with issuer credit the two models differ (QuantLib's Tsiveriotis-Fernandes split against Finstack's jump-to-default equity tree), so only the credit-free lattice is compared. The bond pays no coupon because QuantLib forfeits a coupon on conversion and Finstack retains it.

dv01.tolerance_reason: Both sides price the same Black-Scholes convertible on a binomial lattice: QuantLib at 17536 steps (within about 2e-6 of its own extrapolated continuous limit) and Finstack at 1096 steps. DV01 is a 1bp parallel continuous zero shift of the risk-free curve. QuantLib's fixed-node lattices (CRR, Trigeorgis) at 1096 and 1097 steps lie within 2.4e-4 of the reference DV01; the tolerance allows about four times that, in line with one step in 1096.

npv.tolerance_reason: Both sides price the same Black-Scholes convertible on a binomial lattice: QuantLib at 17536 steps (within about 2e-6 of its own extrapolated continuous limit) and Finstack at 1096 steps. The bound is the lattice discretization at 1096 steps: QuantLib's CRR, Jarrow-Rudd, Tian and Trigeorgis lattices at 1096 and 1097 steps all lie within 3.6e-5 of the reference, and the tolerance allows about three times that.
